import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 12;
    static final int INF = 1000000;
    static final int MAXNODE = 205; // Note: actual max nodes may be larger, but we follow original

    static int N, T;
    static char[][] G1 = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static char[][] G2 = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] A = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][][][] R = new int[MAXN][MAXN][MAXN][MAXN];

    static int[] dx = {-1,1,0,0};
    static int[] dy = {0,0,-1,1};

    static class Dinic {
        static class Edge {
            int a, b, cap, flow;
            Edge(int a, int b, int cap, int flow) {
                this.a = a; this.b = b; this.cap = cap; this.flow = flow;
            }
        }

        int n, s, t;
        ArrayList<Edge> e = new ArrayList<>();
        ArrayList<ArrayList<Integer>> g = new ArrayList<>();
        int[] d, ptr, q;

        Dinic(int n) {
            this.n = n;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) g.add(new ArrayList<>());
            d = new int[n];
            ptr = new int[n];
            q = new int[n];
        }

        void addEdge(int a, int b, int cap) {
            Edge e1 = new Edge(a, b, cap, 0);
            Edge e2 = new Edge(b, a, 0, 0);
            g.get(a).add(e.size());
            e.add(e1);
            g.get(b).add(e.size());
            e.add(e2);
        }

        boolean bfs() {
            int qh = 0, qt = 0;
            q[qt++] = s;
            Arrays.fill(d, -1);
            d[s] = 0;
            while (qh < qt && d[t] == -1) {
                int v = q[qh++];
                for (int id : g.get(v)) {
                    int to = e.get(id).b;
                    if (d[to] == -1 && e.get(id).flow < e.get(id).cap) {
                        q[qt++] = to;
                        d[to] = d[v] + 1;
                    }
                }
            }
            return d[t] != -1;
        }

        int dfs(int v, int fl) {
            if (fl == 0) return 0;
            if (v == t) return fl;
            for (; ptr[v] < g.get(v).size(); ++ptr[v]) {
                int id = g.get(v).get(ptr[v]);
                int to = e.get(id).b;
                if (d[to] != d[v] + 1) continue;
                int pushed = dfs(to, Math.min(fl, e.get(id).cap - e.get(id).flow));
                if (pushed > 0) {
                    e.get(id).flow += pushed;
                    e.get(id ^ 1).flow -= pushed;
                    return pushed;
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        int maxflow() {
            int flow = 0;
            while (true) {
                if (!bfs()) break;
                Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
                while (true) {
                    int pushed = dfs(s, INF);
                    if (pushed == 0) break;
                    flow += pushed;
                }
            }
            return flow;
        }
    }

    static boolean canReach(int sx, int sy, int tx, int ty) {
        if (G1[sx][sy] == 'Y' || G1[sx][sy] == 'Z' || G1[tx][ty] == 'Y' || G1[tx][ty] == 'Z')
            return false;

        int[][] dist = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
            Arrays.fill(dist[i], INF);

        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        dist[sx][sy] = 0;
        q.add(new int[]{sx, sy});

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int x = cur[0], y = cur[1];
            if (x == tx && y == ty) return true;
            if (dist[x][y] >= T || dist[x][y] >= A[x][y]) continue;
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int nx = x + dx[d], ny = y + dy[d];
                if (nx >= 0 && nx < N && ny >= 0 && ny < N &&
                    G1[nx][ny] != 'Y' && G1[nx][ny] != 'Z' &&
                    dist[nx][ny] == INF &&
                    dist[x][y] + 1 <= A[nx][ny]) {
                    dist[nx][ny] = dist[x][y] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        N = sc.nextInt();
        T = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume rest of line

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                G1[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                G2[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }

        // Initialize A with INF
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
            Arrays.fill(A[i], INF);

        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int x = 0; x < N; x++) {
            for (int y = 0; y < N; y++) {
                if (G1[x][y] == 'Z') {
                    for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                        int nx = x + dx[d], ny = y + dy[d];
                        if (nx >= 0 && nx < N && ny >= 0 && ny < N && G1[nx][ny] != 'Y') {
                            A[nx][ny] = 1;
                            q.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int x = cur[0], y = cur[1];
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int nx = x + dx[d], ny = y + dy[d];
                if (nx >= 0 && nx < N && ny >= 0 && ny < N &&
                    G1[nx][ny] != 'Y' && G1[nx][ny] != 'Z' && A[nx][ny] == INF) {
                    A[nx][ny] = A[x][y] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }

        // Compute R
        for (int x1 = 0; x1 < N; x1++)
            for (int y1 = 0; y1 < N; y1++)
                for (int x2 = 0; x2 < N; x2++)
                    for (int y2 = 0; y2 < N; y2++)
                        R[x1][y1][x2][y2] = canReach(x1, y1, x2, y2) ? 1 : 0;

        int totalNodes = 2 * N * N + 2;
        Dinic din = new Dinic(totalNodes);
        din.s = 0;
        din.t = 2 * N * N + 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                if (G1[i][j] > '0' && G1[i][j] <= '9')
                    din.addEdge(din.s, 1 + i * N + j, G1[i][j] - '0');
                if (G2[i][j] > '0' && G2[i][j] <= '9')
                    din.addEdge(N * N + 1 + i * N + j, din.t, G2[i][j] - '0');
            }
        }

        for (int x1 = 0; x1 < N; x1++)
            for (int y1 = 0; y1 < N; y1++)
                for (int x2 = 0; x2 < N; x2++)
                    for (int y2 = 0; y2 < N; y2++)
                        if (R[x1][y1][x2][y2] == 1)
                            din.addEdge(1 + x1 * N + y1, N * N + 1 + x2 * N + y2, INF);

        System.out.println(din.maxflow());
        sc.close();
    }
}
